title: Largest available container ship capacity by year

source.name: Evolution and upsizing of container vessels; largest available containership series
source.publisher: Marine Insight / Port Economics, Management and Policy

notes: The world's largest container ship grew from about 6,600 TEU (1996) to 12,500 TEU (2006 E/Emma-class) to 18,000 TEU (2013 Triple E-class) to 24,000 TEU (2019 Megamax-class).
